product_metadata.title: 13" Splatter Screen, Stainless Steel Fine Mesh. Resting Feet
features: No boiling hot oil, sizzling sauce, liquid splatter or bits projection. Avoid mess and hazards. Cook safely
Large 13" mesh screen covers any size pots and pans. Perfect for family, couples or single household
Doubles as a strainer by flipping pot over the screen. Drain everything with the finely weaved, rust-resistant mesh
Ergonomic design securely jointed, seamlessly extends to boast resting feet for stable rest on countertop
description: Hosting a dinner party and bringing out the big pots and pans? Deterred by the amount of bits projection and splatter of other ingredients? Culina 13" Stainless Steel Mesh Screen, splatter or hazardous boiling oil don’t have to be part of your cooking experience. Ergonomic design, multi-use The large 13" mesh screen accommodates all size pots and pans. Protects against messy splatter, hazardous boiling oil or other food and bits projection such as tomato sauce. Culina 13" Mesh Splatter Screen conveniently doubles as a strainer. In addition to keeping your hands from the heat, the handle is securely jointed to the rim of the screen and seamlessly extends to boast resting feet to conveniently sit the splatter screen on the stovetop or countertop. The sturdy handle affords users a firm and secure grip. Better than a lid for tastier results Don't be discouraged by messy cooking, instead, cover the pan with the anti-splatter screen. As an added bonus check on the food with the convenience of an uncovered pan. When recipe doesn't require a lid, (which often changes heat distribution), a perfect compromise is Culina 13" Mesh Screen to contain the splatter and still maintain a stable heat level as air escapes. Strong-built, durable quality With a reliable, stainless steel construction to withstand daily use and repeated handling over the years, Culina 13" Splatter Screen will last you a lifetime. It's easy to wash with a simple swipe of the dish brush; rinse with the kitchen hose and voila! Its slim frame makes it storage-friendly as it can slide anywhere between pots and pans in the cabinet. All in all, a great housewarming or college send away idea for the cooking enthusiast in your life.
